timelines.title: Prepare
timelines.description: Remove all threads and needles from the serger before starting maintenance or replacing any parts.

timelines.title: Clean
timelines.description: Remove dust, lint, and fabric scraps from inside the serger to keep it clean and running smoothly.

timelines.title: Replace the Knives
timelines.description: Replace damaged or dull knives and install the new lower and upper blades securely in the correct position.

timelines.title: Replace the Needles
timelines.description: Insert the needles with the flat side facing the back, push them fully up, then tighten them securely.

timelines.title: Thread the Serger
timelines.description: Follow the numbered and color-coded threading paths in the correct order, using tweezers to guide the thread through tight areas.

timelines.title: Adjust the Tension
timelines.description: Test the stitch on scrap fabric and make small tension adjustments until the threads sit evenly along the fabric edge.

timelines.title: Finish the Thread Tails
timelines.description: Tuck the serger tail back into the stitches with a hook tool, then trim the excess thread to keep the seam secure.
